strings.name: Karol G
strings.summary: Karol G emerged from Medellín’s musical environment and television competition, developing reggaeton, Latin pop and collaborations. Mañana Será Bonito marked chart and award breakthroughs; Tropicoqueta explored broader Latin traditions. Her albums and major performances expand women’s presence in urban music, including becoming Coachella’s first Latina headliner.
